notes.title: November 2024 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, agents.

We're releasing a new update today. 

[list]
[*] Flag inventory completely redesigned
[*] Minor tweaks to texts and interface
[*] Source code improvements and refactoring
[/list]

We hope you all enjoy. Thanks for playing.

Regards.

notes.title: Operation: SMOKESCREEN

notes.title: November 2023 Update Available Now
notes.content:
Hello, agents.

We're releasing a new update today. 

This minor update adds an in-game option to accept or reject the flags dropping. It can be changed at any time, as you wish. Also, It resolves an issue where the player would use the L-Pill before the stats was computed. Other minor tweaks to texts and interface, too.

Also, the new operation is planned for next month, adding 20 new flags in the collection.

An important note about the flag inventory. Gradually, the images are undergoing a color and border normalization process, changing their appearance.

We hope you all enjoy. Thanks for playing.

Regards.

tags.feature: This minor update adds an in-game option to accept or reject the flags dropping.

notes.title: April 2023 Update Available Now
notes.content:
Hey, agents! 

We're releasing a new update today. This minor update resolves an issue where an agency tries to compromise another agency. Also, the Safe Zones are no longer available in the endgame (after special missions). Other minor tweaks to texts and interface.

Regards. Thanks for playing.
